
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the enumeration constant associated with a supported SGD
    classification penalty value.

    Downstream consumers of this function should *not* rely on specific integer
    values (e.g., `ELASTICNET == 0`). Instead, the function should be
    used in an opaque manner.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Penalty value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: integer|null
        Enumeration constant.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( 'elasticnet' )
    <number>
    > out = {{alias}}(
    ... {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd-classification/penalty-str2enum}}(
    ... 'elasticnet' ) )
    <number>

    See Also
    --------
